de: The upcoming weekend in Central Russia will be warm autumn weather, and on Sunday, October 25, the temperature in Moscow will be from 12 to 15 degrees Celsius.

te: Biologist Abolitz explained why bears no longer perceive humans as a threat
de: Humans have become much less likely to hunt bears, which has led to the fact that the animal now does not perceive humans as a threat.
